peerPreparationHistory: Initial peer guessed per-phase source.h, then guessed combined -I argument. Original argv uses separate -I and private isolated-kernel directory. Both initial reports/helpers retained; only peer lookups corrected, original subject unchanged.
limitations: Only the17-method source-index suite, not full aggregate/ledger/architecture/performance or seven jobs.
Original compiler/native text streams are preserved decoded text, not newly reconstructed raw OS bytes.
R1 linker path collision is retained as a test defect, never a semantic mutation kill.
Package/publication completeness is a separate later check; this review reads the terminal original trees.
